It is a pharmaceutical benefit management (PBM) organization, not a drug seller or distributor. It processes electronic medicine claims and manages health benefits for medical funds.

Mediscor PBM
is not a pharmaceutical manufacturer and does not produce drug product brands. Instead, it is an independent
Pharmaceutical Benefit Management (PBM)
organization in Southern Africa that specializes in electronic real-time medicine claims adjudication, electronic switching, and chronic benefit management for medical schemes and insurers.
LinkedIn South Africa
Mediscor PBM
Core Services & Solutions
Rather than specific consumer product brands, Mediscor's proprietary product offerings focus on healthcare administration technology:
Mediscor ChroniLine®
: A specialized chronic medicine and condition authorization management system.
Real-Time Adjudication (RTA)
: Electronic verification and processing of pharmacy and dispensing doctor claims against medical fund rules.
Mediscor Reference Pricing (MRP)
: Benchmarking models used by medical schemes to manage generic medicine cost alternatives.
